digest.component_or_area: live DC store-copy fixture and scrub (tests/external/live_jira_dc)
propositions: The dc_store_copy_repo fixture scrubs .bridge_state* and commits, but run_ensures() then unconditionally re-creates .bridge_state/projects.json via the projects-seed ensure unit, resurrecting the scrubbed artifact.
The projects-seed ensure unit (added in commit 72731d3745) checks for .bridge_state/projects.json in git and commits its creation when missing, defeating the one-shot scrub's removal.

After run_ensures converges the store, .bridge_state/ survives in both worktree and tickets tree, causing test_the_store_copy_is_complete_and_scrubbed to fail with binding/snapshot artifacts assertion.
The fix is to extract a scrub_bridge_state helper and re-run the .bridge_state* glob removal after run_ensures (with commit=True) to clean up the resurrected artifact while preserving .env-id.
A fast regression test in test_dc_store_copy_fetch_diagnostics.py drives the real seed unit to reproduce the resurrection and verify the post-converge re-scrub removes .bridge_state* cleanly.
